text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I call Narita Brian over so I can give her
some fan
mail.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If that's everything, I'll be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to read it?
Aren't you going to read it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's my letter. What I do with it is my
business,
right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Just please don't throw it away!
Just please don't throw it away!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm just not going to read it here. That's
all I
meant.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'd never throw away a letter from a fan...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian carefully puts the fan letter
in her
pocket, then leaves brusquely.
